Our services

How CODM supports public sector cloud programmes

CODM provides professional services to help organisations plan, implement, integrate, develop, support and improve cloud-based systems.

Salesforce advisory, implementation and optimisation

We help organisations get more value from Salesforce through discovery, solution design, configuration, development, deployment and ongoing optimisation.

Our expertise includes Salesforce CRM and Salesforce industry clouds, including Education Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Health and Insurance Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Energy and Utilities Cloud, and Manufacturing Cloud.

AI, Agentforce and intelligent automation

We support the practical use of AI in cloud services. This includes assessing opportunities, designing AI-enabled workflows, implementing Agentforce and Salesforce AI capabilities, and developing LLM-enabled applications.

Our focus is on automation that reduces repetitive work, improves access to information and supports better operational decisions.

API integration, data integration and migration

We help organisations connect cloud platforms with the systems and data they rely on. Our services include API integration, integration-framework design, data integration and data migration.

We work to improve the flow, quality and availability of information across systems.

Cloud application development

CODM develops and enhances cloud-connected applications using React and Microsoft .NET. We support responsive user interfaces, supporting applications, integrations and digital services that work alongside existing cloud platforms.

Technical support and continuous improvement

We provide deployment support, technical troubleshooting, performance optimisation, platform enhancements and ongoing support for cloud-based services.

Public service outcomes

Supporting better public service outcomes

CODM helps public sector teams use cloud technology to improve how services are delivered, managed and developed.

  • Improve service, stakeholder and case-management workflows.
  • Connect cloud platforms with existing systems and data sources.
  • Reduce manual administration through workflow and AI automation.
  • Improve the reliability, usability and performance of cloud services.
  • Deliver modern digital experiences through Salesforce, React and .NET.
  • Build a clearer view of service interactions, operational data and outcomes.
Relevant sectors

Public sector contexts we support

CODM’s Cloud Support capabilities are relevant to organisations across a range of public service contexts.

Healthcare and health-related services

Support joined-up service delivery with CRM, integrated data, workflow automation and cloud application development.

Higher education and learning services

Improve learner, alumni and stakeholder engagement with Education Cloud, CRM automation, integrated data and digital self-service services.

Financial and regulatory services

Support customer and case-management processes with Salesforce, integrations, secure access and data-informed workflows.

Manufacturing and operational services

Connect teams, systems and information to improve operational visibility, service workflows and digital processes.

Energy and utilities

Support customer-facing and operational services with connected cloud systems, automation, integrations and scalable applications.

Transport and telecommunications

Improve service operations, field-team coordination and customer experiences through connected data, cloud platforms and workflow automation.

Our approach

How we work

01

Understand the requirement

We begin by understanding your objectives, current systems, delivery context and the outcomes you need to achieve.

02

Define a practical approach

We work with you to shape an approach that may include discovery, advisory support, solution design, configuration, development, integration, migration or technical support.

03

Deliver and improve

We support implementation and deployment, then help your team optimise services, resolve technical issues and plan future improvements.

Why CODM

Cloud expertise that supports delivery

Salesforce and cloud delivery expertise

CODM brings hands-on experience across Salesforce CRM, industry clouds, application development, integrations, data and technical support.

Technology that works together

We focus on connecting systems, data and teams, not introducing isolated tools. Our services are designed to help cloud platforms work effectively within your wider technology environment.

Practical AI delivery

We approach AI as a way to improve real workflows and service outcomes. We help teams identify suitable use cases and implement automation with a clear operational purpose.

Support from discovery to improvement

Our team can support different stages of a cloud programme, from early advisory work and delivery through to technical support and continuous improvement.
